data.body: **[P2] Handle same-key context re-entry before starting another span.** During timed in-process re-entry, a checkpointed CONTEXT can retain `context_replay=False`, so this starts another recording span with the same deterministic ID. `_start_span()` overwrites the registry entry without ending the first span, and invocation cleanup can reach only the replacement. Reuse the existing per-invocation context span, or end it and force a fresh linked ID; add a re-entry test asserting the original span stops recording.
